title: 아메리카노 주문
description: 카페에 들어가 바리스타에게 아이스 아메리카노를 주문하는 상황입니다.

turns.foreignerLine: Hi! What can I get for you today?
Would you like that iced or hot?
What size would you like?
Can I get a name for the order?
That'll be $4.50. Will that be cash or card?

title: 커스텀 음료 주문
description: 사이즈 변경, 샷 추가 등 세부 옵션을 지정하며 음료를 주문하는 상황입니다.
goal: 커스텀 옵션을 모두 정확히 전달하여 주문에 성공하세요.

turns.foreignerLine: Hi there! What can I get started for you?
What size would you like — tall, grande, or venti?
How many espresso shots would you like?
Any milk preference? We have oat, almond, or regular.
Anything else to add, like syrups or toppings?

title: 탑승구 위치 묻기
description: 공항에서 직원에게 탑승구 위치를 물어보는 상황입니다.
goal: 탑승구 위치를 파악하고 감사 인사까지 마무리하세요.

turns.foreignerLine: Hello, can I help you?
Which gate are you looking for?
Do you have your boarding pass handy?
It's at the end of Terminal B, past security checkpoint 3.
Is there anything else you need help with?

title: 수하물 분실 신고
description: 수하물이 도착하지 않아 공항 직원에게 분실 신고를 하는 상황입니다.
goal: 분실 신고서 접수를 완료하고 연락처를 남기세요.

turns.foreignerLine: Hello, how can I assist you?
Can you describe your bag for me?
What flight did you arrive on?
Can I have your contact number and local address?
We'll contact you within 24 hours. Is that okay?

title: 호텔 체크인
description: 호텔 프런트에서 체크인 절차를 진행하는 상황입니다.

turns.foreignerLine: Good evening! Welcome. Do you have a reservation?
Can I see your ID and the credit card used for booking?
Would you prefer a smoking or non-smoking room?
Breakfast is included — it starts at 7am in the dining hall.
Here's your key card. Your room is on the 5th floor.

title: 룸 컴플레인
description: 에어컨 고장 등 객실 문제를 프런트에 신고하고 해결을 요청하는 상황입니다.
goal: 문제 상황을 정확히 설명하고 해결 방법에 합의하세요.

turns.foreignerLine: Front desk, how can I help you?
I'm sorry to hear that. What seems to be the issue?
How long has this been going on?
Would you like us to send a technician, or would you prefer a different room?
We'll have someone up within 15 minutes. Apologies for the inconvenience.

title: 메뉴 추천받고 주문
description: 식당에서 직원에게 추천 메뉴를 물어보고 주문하는 상황입니다.

turns.foreignerLine: Hi, welcome! Are you ready to order or do you need a moment?
Our most popular dish today is the grilled salmon. Would you like to try that?
Would you like that with a side salad or fries?
Anything to drink with that?
Great choice! I'll have that right out for you.

title: 알레르기 확인 후 주문
description: 알레르기 재료가 포함됐는지 확인하고 안전한 메뉴를 주문하는 상황입니다.
goal: 알레르기 재료를 확인하고 적절한 메뉴를 주문하세요.

turns.foreignerLine: Hi, are you ready to order?
Do you have any food allergies I should know about?
The pasta contains gluten and dairy — is that okay?
We do have a gluten-free option. Would you like to try that?
Perfect. I'll let the kitchen know about your allergy. Just to confirm — no nuts, correct?

title: 목적지 말하기
description: 택시 기사에게 목적지를 말하고 출발하는 상황입니다.

turns.foreignerLine: Hey, where to?
Do you have the address?
Is that near downtown?
Alright, estimated time is about 15 minutes. Is that okay?
Great, let's go!

title: 전화로 길 설명하기
description: 기사가 목적지를 못 찾아 전화로 길을 설명해야 하는 상황입니다.
goal: 랜드마크와 방향을 활용해 위치를 정확히 안내하세요.

turns.foreignerLine: Hello? I'm having trouble finding your location.
I'm near a big intersection — can you describe any landmarks nearby?
Okay, I see a convenience store. Should I turn left or right?
How far down should I go after the turn?
Okay, I think I can see you now. Are you waving?
